text:
carla: dropped a lightweight IA proposal: collapse Models + Serving + Jobs into a single 'Model Workspace' cluster, add a tiny shortcut row (Recent • Starred • All), and tighten canonical paths. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder-workspace :sparkles:
ben: nice. main ask: stable deep links for alerts/docs. can you list canonical paths you want so ops can plan redirects? :clipboard:
yara: sketch for canonical paths:
- /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models -> models list
- /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId -> model overview (tabs: info, serving, metrics)
- nested canonical: /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId/serving/:servId/runs/:runId
- use fragment/hash for ephemeral UI state: #panel=logs or #drawer=deploy-config
tim: UX concern: if Deployments are nested, discoverability for high-volume orgs drops. suggest a persistent "Jump: Deployments" pill in the shortcut row when counts>0. also show counts in parentheses.
carla: thumbs up to the Jump pill. copy debate: label top-level "Serving" vs "Deployments" vs "Runs"? product-bot: support data shows search queries: "deployments" (45%), "runs" (30%), "serving" (25%). recommendation: top label "Deployments" with microcopy in expanded view: "(runs, serving)".
ben: accessibility: when landing from a deep link, focus should go to page H1 and active breadcrumb should have aria-current. collapsed breadcrumbs should expose full path via aria-label even if visually truncated. screenreader-bot: will add automated checks.
yara: breadcrumb UX: collapse middle segments when >3 and show ellipsis; tooltip shows full path; include a copy-permalink icon that copies canonical path (no query/hash).
tim: technical detail: prefer path tokens for canonical routing (no ?tab=). queries/fragments ok for ephemeral UI state. Also propose a small mapping table for legacy->new routes shipped with client-side fallback for 12 months and server redirects for 12 months, extendable based on telemetry. infra-bot: will create a redirect ticket and daily telemetry dashboard for legacy hits.
carla: agree on 12 months to start. we'll measure. dev note: routing helpers should expose two helpers: buildCanonicalPath(resource) and parseIncomingPath(path) to map legacy tokens. Put in src/routes/paths.ts.
ben: e2e checklist: open direct /orgs/x/projects/y/models/123/serving/456/runs/789 -> assert sidebar highlights Model Workspace, Jump pill visible, breadcrumb shows truncated middle but aria-label reads full path, focus on H1. Also test opening with fragment #panel=logs opens logs drawer but does not alter canonical path.
yara: a11y nit: ensure contrast for active sidebar item >= 4.5:1 for small text; keyboard users must be able to expand collapsed breadcrumb and navigate crumbs. screenreader-bot: adding keyboard SR tests.
carla: small copy tweak: microcopy under nav item: "(runs & jobs)" — keeps non-ML folks from being confused. tim: can we add an optional compact mode for orgs with lots of items (auto-enabled)? reduces height.
ben: routing/pasteable urls: include a short description in the PR about which parts are considered canonical, which are ephemeral. helps external teams linking into product.
product-bot: will coordinate docs updates and outreach to partners with the list of changed URLs.
infra-bot: staging deploy queued for 2026-11-02T06:00:00Z. preview link will be posted in this thread when available. :rocket:
carla: thanks team — i'll update figma, push a small RFC with the mapping table, attach the accessibility checklist, and schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow 11am PT. :thumbsup:
